PILL.KEEP_ONE: At least one media type has to stay selected

EMPTY.NO_FAVORITES_HINT: Right-click an item to add it
EMPTY.NO_RECORDINGS_HINT: Schedule one from a channel's TV guide
EMPTY.NO_GUIDE_HINT: Add XMLTV sources in Settings, and make sure your channels' tvg-id matches the guide.
EMPTY.NOTHING_TO_CONTINUE_HINT: Movies and episodes you started show up here and resume where you left off
EMPTY.NO_RECORDING_FILES_HINT: Recordings and downloads are saved in the recording folder (Settings → Recording)
EMPTY.LOAD_FAILED: This view could not be loaded
EMPTY.LOAD_FAILED_HINT: Check the connection to your source and try again

SHORTCUT.TOGGLE_FAVORITE: Add/remove the focused item to/from favorites
SHORTCUT.OPEN_CONTEXT_MENU: Open the focused item's menu (also the Menu key)

GENERAL.DEFAULT_VIEW_DESC: Screen shown when the app starts.
GENERAL.DEFAULT_SORT_DESC: Order in which channels are listed.
GENERAL.REFRESH_ON_START_DESC: Update every source automatically when the app launches.
GENERAL.AUTO_REFRESH_DESC: Refresh channels from your sources in the background.
GENERAL.VOLUME_ON_START_DESC: Initial mpv volume when playback starts.
GENERAL.UI_ZOOM_DESC: Scale of the entire interface, in percent.
GENERAL.TRAY_ICON_DESC: Keep the app running in the system tray. Disabling this also disables programme reminders.
GENERAL.AUTO_UPDATE_DESC: Look for a new version at startup and offer to install it

APPEARANCE.THEME_DESC: Color scheme for the interface. System follows your OS preference.
APPEARANCE.ACCENT_DESC: Highlight color used for buttons and interactive controls.
APPEARANCE.SHOW_SOURCE_DESC: Display the source name under each channel and programme title.
APPEARANCE.COUNTRY_PREFIX_DESC: How prefixes such as “TR:” or “DE |” in front of channel names are shown.

PLAYBACK.CACHING_DESC: Buffer streams before playback. Disabling can lower latency depending on your provider and connection.
PLAYBACK.HWDEC_DESC: Decode video on the GPU instead of the CPU. Adds hwdec=auto to the mpv config.
PLAYBACK.GPU_DESC: Enable HDR and GPU playback via gpu-next. Adds --vo=gpu-next --gpu-api=vulkan to the mpv config.
PLAYBACK.PLAYER_UI_DESC: Style of the built-in player's on-screen controls.
PLAYBACK.NORMALIZE_DESC: Even out loudness differences between channels.
PLAYBACK.EXTERNAL_PLAYER_DESC: Open streams in another player instead of the built-in one. Recording always uses the built-in player.
PLAYBACK.EXTERNAL_PLAYER_PATH_DESC: Path to the player executable that receives the stream.
PLAYBACK.EXTERNAL_ARGS_DESC: Arguments passed to the external player. {url} is replaced with the stream URL; without it the URL is appended last.
PLAYBACK.LANG_DESC: ISO 639 codes mpv should pick by default. Separate fallbacks with commas, highest priority first.
PLAYBACK.MPV_PARAMS_DESC: Launch parameters applied to every channel. Leave empty unless you know what you are doing.
PLAYBACK.DEBUG_LOG_DESC: For troubleshooting only: mpv.log in the log folder records every stream address, including the login data in it. Takes effect the next time the player opens.
PLAYBACK.AUTO_FALLBACK: Switch to another stream of the channel when one fails
PLAYBACK.AUTO_FALLBACK_DESC: If a live stream fails, the player automatically switches to another quality of the same channel, for example from HD to SD.
PLAYBACK.APPLIES_NEXT_CHANNEL: Takes effect with the next channel

RECORDING.PATH_DESC: Folder where recordings and downloads are saved.
RECORDING.ALWAYS_ASK_DESC: Open a file dialog for every download and recording. Overrides the recording path.
RECORDING.RESET_DEFAULT_TOOLTIP: Save recordings in the default folder again

NETWORK.RESTREAM_PORT_DESC: Local port used when re-streaming a channel to other devices.
NETWORK.RESTREAM_PORT_INVALID: Enter a port from {{min}} to {{max}}, or leave the field empty for the default.

EPG.TITLE: External EPG
EPG.INTRO: When a channel has no guide data from its provider, streameo fills it in from these XMLTV sources: matched by tvg-id, otherwise by channel name, or as you assign it by hand. Any XMLTV URL works (for example an IPTV-EPG.org export); .xml and .xml.gz are both supported.
EPG.REFRESH_DESC: Download the latest guide data. This also happens automatically on your source auto-refresh schedule, or once a day when that is off.
EPG.FREE_SOURCES_DESC: Add a known free XMLTV guide with one click. Pick the ones that match your channels' countries.
EPG.SOURCES_LIST_DESC: Guides are loaded in this order. Each one shows when it was last loaded and what it contains.
EPG.NO_SOURCES: No XMLTV sources yet. Add a URL below or pick one of the free sources.
EPG.INVALID_URL: Enter a complete URL starting with http:// or https://.
EPG.DUPLICATE_URL: This source is already in the list.
EPG.COVERAGE: {{matched}} of {{live}} live channels have guide data.
EPG.COVERAGE_HINT: Channels without a match can be assigned by hand: open the channel's menu and choose “Assign EPG…”.
EPG.DUPLICATE_COUNTRY: {{country}} is covered by {{count}} sources – duplicate sources only make the refresh slower.

DATA.BACKUP_DESC: Save all sources, channels, favorites and settings to a file.
DATA.RESTORE_DESC: Replace all current data with a previously saved backup.
DATA.EXPORT_FAVORITES_DESC: Save your favorite channels as an M3U playlist usable in any player.
DATA.CLEAR_HISTORY_DESC: Remove all items from the recently watched list.
DATA.DELETE_ALL_DESC: Remove all sources, channels, favorites and settings. Use this if an upgrade did not fix a bug you are experiencing.
DATA.LOG_FOLDER_DESC: Open the folder with the log files of the app and the player.
DATA.DIAGNOSTICS_DESC: Contains no passwords or stream addresses, so you can attach it to a bug report.

RESTORE_MODAL.TITLE: Confirm database restore
RESTORE_MODAL.BODY1: This action will replace all current data (sources, channels, categories, favorites and settings) with the contents of the selected backup.
RESTORE_MODAL.BODY2: Everything added or changed since that backup was created will be lost. This cannot be undone.

DIALOG.SAVE_BACKUP: Select where to save the database backup
DIALOG.SAVE_FAVORITES: Select where to save the favorites playlist
DIALOG.SAVE_DIAGNOSTICS: Select where to save the diagnostics report

PARENTAL.DESC: Protect groups with a PIN. Locked groups and their channels stay hidden until the PIN is entered with the lock button on the home page. Lock a group from its context menu in Categories.
PARENTAL.REMOVE_PIN_DESC: Enter the current PIN. All locked groups are unlocked.

SETUP.M3U_FILE_TOOLTIP: Use this option if you only have an M3U file. If the file was obtained through a URL given to you by your IPTV provider, the M3U URL option is better
SETUP.M3U_URL_TOOLTIP: If you want your channel list to refresh automatically with new channels added by your IPTV provider, this option is recommended over the M3U file
SETUP.SOURCE_NAME_TAKEN: This source name is already taken
SETUP.USE_TVG_ID: Use TVG-ID for names when TVG-NAME is unavailable
SETUP.XTREAM_URL_HINT: Server address in the form http://host:port
SETUP.INVALID_URL: "{{url}}" is not a valid URL. Check it for spaces or typos.
SETUP.XTREAM_DETECTED_BODY1: This M3U link contains an Xtream login. Imported as an Xtream source, you get your provider's EPG, catch-up for missed programmes and series sorted by season.
SETUP.XTREAM_DETECTED_BODY2: Importing it as Xtream is recommended, but you can also import it as a plain M3U link.
SETUP.EPG_INTRO: Free guides show what is on your channels – pick the ones for your channels' countries (you can change this later in the settings).
SETUP.DONE_TEXT: Your source is set up. Enjoy watching!
SETUP.IMPORT_FAILED: The file could not be imported
SETUP.ADD_CUSTOM_FAILED: The custom source could not be created
SETUP.FETCH_FAILED: The list could not be loaded. Check the link and your internet connection.
SETUP.XTREAM_TOOLTIP: Log in with the server address, username and password from your provider. Gives you the provider's EPG, catch-up and series sorted by season.
SETUP.CUSTOM_TOOLTIP: An empty source to which you add channels and categories yourself.
SETUP.CUSTOM_IMPORT_TOOLTIP: Imports a custom source exported from streameoIPTV (.siptvp file).

EPG.NOTIFY_NEEDS_TRAY: Reminders need the tray icon (Settings → General)

RESTREAM.TITLE: Re-streaming: {{name}}
RESTREAM.INTRO1: If your IPTV service does not allow more than one connection, the re-streaming feature allows you to share any livestream with friends and family over LAN/WAN
RESTREAM.INTRO2: Press start to launch the re-streaming service. Instructions to share your re-streamed livestream will appear below along with its status
RESTREAM.RUNNING: Running and accessible from the following ips...
RESTREAM.SHARE_INFO1: Select an IP and press the Export… button below to generate a .siptv file. You can share this file with your friends so they can import it in streameoIPTV and watch your re-streamed content.
RESTREAM.SHARE_INFO2: You can import .siptv files in streameoIPTV by having or creating a custom source. Make sure to select the right IP for the right context; sharing a .siptv file with one of your local IPs will not work for someone outside your LAN.
RESTREAM.NETWORK_UNAVAILABLE: Network information is unavailable, so re-streaming cannot be started.

DOWNLOAD.TITLE: Downloads
DOWNLOAD.PAUSED_HINT: Queue paused - running downloads finish, no new ones are started

EDIT_GROUP.NAME: Name
EDIT_GROUP.NAME_TAKEN: This group name is already taken

DELETE_GROUP.TITLE: Choose a replacement category
DELETE_GROUP.NOTICE: The channels under the deleted category will be transferred to the new category. If you leave this field empty, the channels will no longer have a category

CONFIRM_DELETE.TITLE: Confirm deletion of all user data
CONFIRM_DELETE.BODY1: This action will delete all user data including channels, categories and favorites for all sources.
CONFIRM_DELETE.BODY2: It is recommended to use this option if you're encountering weird bugs that may be due to a version upgrade.
CONFIRM_DELETE.APP_CLOSES: The app closes afterwards. Start it again to set it up from scratch.

CONFIRM_URL.TITLE: Is this the right URL?
CONFIRM_URL.BODY1: Your URL does not seem to point to an Xtream API server. You can proceed anyway; if you then get an error, choose “Correct URL automatically” on your next attempt.
CONFIRM_URL.BODY2: If the automatic URL correction still fails, please contact your provider to obtain its proper Xtream API URL or proper credentials.

IMPORT.TITLE: Override import name
IMPORT.NOTICE: Optionally choose a new name for the import (to avoid duplicates, for example)
IMPORT.NAME: Name

ERROR.TITLE: Error
ERROR.OCCURRED: The following error has occurred, you may report it here
ERROR.ATTACH_LOGS: Please attach those logs (if they exist) and the error below to your bug report. Thank you!
ERROR.LOGS_FOLDER_HINT: The log files and a diagnostics report help to find the cause:
ERROR.PERSISTENT_DIAGNOSTICS: If the error keeps coming back, export the diagnostics report and attach it to your report. It contains no passwords or stream addresses.
ERROR.CREDENTIALS_REJECTED: The provider rejected the username or password
ERROR.NOT_XTREAM_SERVER: The server did not answer like an Xtream Codes server
ERROR.NOT_M3U_PLAYLIST: The link does not point to an M3U playlist

SOURCE.USER_AGENT_TOOLTIP: User-Agent sent when fetching and refreshing playlists
SOURCE.MAX_STREAMS_TOOLTIP: Limits the number of concurrent streams. When the limit is reached and a new stream is opened, the oldest stream is closed
SOURCE.XTREAM_HINT: This link contains an Xtream login. As an Xtream source you get your provider's EPG, catch-up for missed programmes and series sorted by season.
SOURCE.MAX_STREAMS_INVALID: Enter a whole number of at least 1

DIALOG.EXPORT_SOURCE: Select where to export custom source
DIALOG.SAVE_CATCHBACK: Select where to save the programme from the archive
DIALOG.SELECT_M3U: Select a new m3u file for source

UPDATE.TITLE: Update available
UPDATE.RESTART_HINT: The app restarts once the update is installed.

CONFIRM.CANCEL_DOWNLOADS_BODY: {{count}} queued or running downloads will be cancelled.
CONFIRM.DELETE_SOURCE_BODY: The source "{{name}}" will be removed together with all of its channels, categories, favorites and history. This cannot be undone.
CONFIRM.CLEAR_HISTORY_BODY: All items will be removed from the recently watched list. This cannot be undone.
CONFIRM.DELETE_CHANNEL_BODY: The channel "{{name}}" will be deleted permanently.
CONFIRM.DELETE_CATEGORY_BODY: The category "{{name}}" will be deleted permanently.
CONFIRM.CANCEL_RECORDING_BODY: The scheduled recording "{{title}}" will be cancelled.
CONFIRM.STOP_RECORDING_BODY: The recording "{{title}}" is running and will be stopped. The part recorded so far stays in the recording folder.
CONFIRM.DELETE_RECORDING_BODY: The file "{{name}}" will be deleted from the recording folder. This cannot be undone.
CONFIRM.REMOVE_PIN_BODY: All locked groups will be unlocked and shown to everyone.
CONFIRM.CONVERT_XTREAM_BODY1: The source is imported again through its Xtream login. Favorites, history, hidden and locked groups and scheduled recordings are kept by channel name.
CONFIRM.CONVERT_XTREAM_BODY2: This takes about as long as refreshing the source. If it fails, the source stays unchanged.
CONFIRM.DELETE_ALERT_REMIND_BODY: Programmes with "{{query}}" in the title will no longer get a reminder automatically.
CONFIRM.DELETE_ALERT_RECORD_BODY: Programmes with "{{query}}" in the title will no longer be recorded automatically.
CONFIRM.DELETE_ALERT_KEEP: Reminders and recordings already created stay. Remove them individually if you no longer want them.
CONFIRM.CLEAR_FINISHED_FAILED_BODY: Failed recordings among them: {{count}}. Their entries are the only sign that these recordings did not work. The recorded files stay in the folder.

PLAYER.ERR_LOADING: the stream could not be opened (server not reachable or link invalid)
PLAYER.ERR_FORMAT: the stream format is not recognized
PLAYER.ERR_NO_DATA: the stream delivered no picture or sound
PLAYER.ERR_AUDIO_OUTPUT: the audio output could not be started
PLAYER.ERR_VIDEO_OUTPUT: the video output could not be started (check the graphics driver)
PLAYER.ERR_UNSUPPORTED: the stream uses a format the player does not support
PLAYER.ERR_NETWORK: the connection to the server failed

GUIDE.NO_CATCHUP: This programme is not available from the archive
GUIDE.SEARCH_LABEL: Search programmes in the TV guide
GUIDE.SEARCH_SCOPE: The search covers the XMLTV guide data of the next 7 days.

GUIDE.ALERT_REMIND_ADDED: You'll be reminded of every programme with "{{query}}" in its title, including ones added to the guide later.
GUIDE.ALERT_RECORD_ADDED: Every programme with "{{query}}" in its title will be recorded, including ones added to the guide later.

GUIDE.EPG_FAILED: Programme data could not be loaded
GUIDE.EPG_RETRY_ARIA: Load the programme data of {{name}} again

PARENTAL.PIN_REMOVED: Parental PIN removed, all groups are unlocked
PARENTAL.SET_PIN_FIRST: Set a parental PIN first (Settings → Parental lock)
PARENTAL.UNLOCK_HINT: Enter the parental PIN to show the locked groups for this session.
PARENTAL.PIN_FORMAT_INVALID: The PIN must be 4 to 8 digits

RECORDINGS.CLEAR_FAILED: Failed to clear the finished recordings
RECORDINGS.FILES_LOAD_FAILED: Failed to load the recorded files

RECORDINGS.FILE_RECORDING_HINT: Still being recorded. Cancel the recording above to delete it.

EPG_MAPPING.XTREAM_NOTE: A guide assigned here replaces your provider's own guide for this channel, and with it catch-up of past programmes.

FAV_LISTS.NAME: Name of the list

FAV_LISTS.UPDATE_FAILED: Failed to change the list “{{list}}” for “{{name}}”

FAV_LISTS.REORDER_HINT: Drag tiles to change the order, or use “Move forward/back” in the context menu
FAV_LISTS.MOVE_FAILED: Failed to save the new order
